assets.local_delta: owned-baseline, independently authored (no code or text copied). Replaces the diagnosing-superpowers skill from the Superpowers plugin, observed installed in this environment's Codex plugin cache, in this repository's execution surface. The upstream skill was read directly (source: MIT-licensed, plain Markdown SKILL.md plus prompts/templates/references) and is a 7-step multi-analyst-subagent forensic workflow (problem intake, locate, parallel-dispatch triage across seven dimensions, report, optional GitHub issue filing, optional scrubbed export bundle, similar-session search) with its own hard rules and anti-rationalization red-flag table. session-forensics keeps only the single-agent shape it converges on (problem definition, environment, session inventory, timeline, categorized findings with evidence+confidence, coverage notes) and drops the parallel-analyst dispatch, issue filing, and export/bundle machinery as unnecessary for Chohogi's debugging route.
